fullPassage: Being alone makes us more creative. Many great artists and thinkers throughout history have lived by themselves. When we are alone, we have fewer distractions. This allows our thoughts to run free without interruption or judgment. Creative people have entire worlds inside their heads, and being alone gives them the opportunity to bring ideas from this inner world into the real world. Steve Wozniak, for example, invented the Apple computer sitting alone at a desk. He says his creativity came from being introverted as a child. Had it not been for his shyness, he might not have become a computer expert. However, this does not mean we should stop working together with others. Had it not been for Wozniak's collaboration with Steve Jobs, he could not have started his own business. Therefore, we should seek out solitude, but only when we need it.

③ allows: 주어 This(단수)에 맞는 단수동사 allows — 적절
④ gives: 'being alone gives' 동명사구 주어는 단수라 gives — 적절
det.tip: 주어=목적어 동일 대상 → 재귀대명사 themselves (by themselves = 스스로)
